admin.releaseNotes: XP Store barcode scanning with the device camera, durable rider live-map telemetry and the exact website Mapcn location experience.

driver.releaseNotes: Clearer pickup handover: the customer sees their delivery code from the moment the food is collected, and the driver confirms it at the door.

restaurant.releaseNotes: Complete light, dark and system themes with consistent text, icons, forms, menu cards, modals and restaurant controls.

customer.releaseNotes: Redesigned restaurant menu screen with aligned cards, plus a delivery code that appears once the food is collected and disappears once the driver confirms the handover.
